# Notice

## Dataset provenance

The financial data underlying this AI specification originates from the [Financial Dataset for SAP Datasphere](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/radhakrushnadev/financial-dataset-for-sap-datasphere) published on Kaggle by radhakrushnadev under the **CC0: Public Domain** license. The dataset is synthetic sample data designed for demonstrating SAP Datasphere and SAP Analytics Cloud integration.
